```js
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';

const records = JSON.parse(readFileSync(new URL('./records.json', import.meta.url), 'utf8'));

const CURSOR_RE = /^c(\d+)$/;

export async function listTools() {
  return [
    {
      name: 'audit_page',
      description: 'Paginate audit records with an opaque cursor.',
      inputSchema: {
        type: 'object',
        properties: {
          limit: { type: 'integer', minimum: 1, maximum: 3 },
          cursor: { type: 'string', description: 'Opaque cursor from a previous next_cursor.' }
        },
        required: ['limit'],
        additionalProperties: false
      }
    }
  ];
}

function fail(message, code = -32602) {
  const err = new Error(message);
  err.code = code;
  throw err;
}

export async function callTool(name, args = {}) {
  if (name !== 'audit_page') {
    fail(`Unknown tool: ${name}`, -32601);
  }

  if (args === null || typeof args !== 'object' || Array.isArray(args)) {
    fail('Invalid arguments');
  }

  const allowed = new Set(['limit', 'cursor']);
  for (const key of Object.keys(args)) {
    if (!allowed.has(key)) {
      fail(`Unknown field: ${key}`);
    }
  }

  const { limit, cursor } = args;

  if (limit === undefined || limit === null) {
    fail('limit is required');
  }
  if (typeof limit !== 'number' || !Number.isInteger(limit) || limit < 1 || limit > 3) {
    fail('limit must be an integer between 1 and 3');
  }

  let offset = 0;
  if (cursor !== undefined && cursor !== null) {
    if (typeof cursor !== 'string') {
      fail('cursor must be a string');
    }
    const m = cursor.match(CURSOR_RE);
    if (!m) {
      fail('Invalid cursor');
    }
    offset = Number(m[1]);
    if (offset < 0 || offset >= records.length) {
      fail('Unknown cursor');
    }
  }

  const slice = records.slice(offset, offset + limit);
  const nextOffset = offset + slice.length;
  const hasMore = nextOffset < records.length;
  const next_cursor = hasMore ? `c${nextOffset}` : null;

  return {
    content: [{ type: 'text', text: JSON.stringify({ records: slice, next_cursor }) }]
  };
}
```
